items.name: Bandung Cubing 2022

venue.name: [Bandung Creative Hub](http://www.bch.my.id/)
venue.address: Jl. Laswi No.7, Kacapiring, Kota Bandung

items.information: # Only 1 guest per competitor is allowed to enter the competition venue. Having speedcubing competitions back to Indonesia and there hasn't been one competition in Bandung for 4 years, we announced that there will be one named Bandung Cubing 2022. All competitors must follow the health protocol to avoid COVID-19 spread. Do not attend if you feel unwell or isolating. If you need more information, you are welcome to contact us through Contact section or through our [community Instagram](https://instagram.com/bandungcuberclub). --- # Hanya 1 pendamping per peserta yang diperbolehkan memasuki lokasi kompetisi. Setelah kompetisi speedcubing kembali ke Indonesia dan tidak ada satu pun kompetisi di Bandung selama 4 tahun, kami mengumumkan bahwa akan ada satu kompetisi bernama Bandung Cubing Comp 2022. Seluruh peserta lomba wajib mengikuti protokol kesehatan untuk menghindari penyebaran COVID-19. Jangan hadir jika Anda merasa tidak sehat atau sedang melakukan isolasi. Jika Anda memerlukan informasi lebih lanjut, Anda dipersilakan untuk menghubungi kami melalui bagian Kontak atau melalui akun komunitas kami di [Instagram](https://instagram.com/bandungcuberclub).

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. --------------------------------------------------------------- Registration is open to all, of all nationalities. Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few.

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MtProspectOpen2022#20297-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please also be sure to review the [Health and Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MtProspectOpen2022#20298-health-safety) tab to check additional COVID-19 requirements for this competition. items.information: O **pagamento** da inscrição deve ser feito **antecipadamente**, todas as instruções se encontram na aba de inscrever-se do campeonato. A inscrição **NÃO** será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir. A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 40 primeiros pagantes. __________________________________________________________________________________________________ The **payment** of the registration fee must be made** in advance**. All the relevant instructions can be found under the register tab. The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition. Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 40 payers.

items.name: Poznań Mental Breakdown 2022
items.information: Zapraszamy na kolejne zawody organizowane w poznańskim klubie snookerowym BrizZon! Tym razem rywalizacja odbędzie się nie w ramach standardowej serii turniejów, lecz w pięciu wymagających konkurencjach - FM, 3-5 BLD oraz MBLD to klasyczny zestaw, który niejednego zawodnika przyprawi o ból głowy. Nie możemy się już ciebie doczekać! We invite you to the next competition organized in the BrizZon snooker club in Poznań! This time the competition will take place not as part of the standard series of tournaments, but in five demanding competitions - FM, 3-5 BLD and MBLD is a classic set that will give many competitors a headache. We are looking forward to you!

items.name: V-Cube Spiel A 2022
items.information: V-Cubes is proud to bring back cubing competitions to Spiel Messe in Essen! **Note:** V-Cube Spiel A 2022 is a series competition to V-Cube Spiel B 2022 on the same day. Please note that you may only register for one of the two competitions. V-Cubes ist stolz darauf, wieder Speedcubing-Turniere auf der SPIEL Messe in Essen präsentieren zu dürfen! **Wichtig:** V-Cube Spiel A 2022 ist eine Partner-Competition von V-Cube Spiel B 2022, die am gleichen Tag stattfindet. Bitte beachte, dass du dich nur für eines der beiden Turniere anmelden darfst. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbDRkIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ef25795363481ab9b918d882fa96ca2c55097150/v-cube.png) To participate in this competition, you must have a ticket for Saturday at the Essen Spiel Messe exposition.
